name: Four Seasons Hotel and Residences Fort Lauderdale
positioning: Beach hotel and residences in a 22-storey tower on Fort Lauderdale Beach, opened in March 2022
best_for: Beach and pool stays with a Kids For All Seasons daily program for children
Travelers who want Evelyn's and MAASS on site

facts.text: The hotel is a 22-storey building with a curved silhouette.
The hotel is at 525 North Fort Lauderdale Beach Boulevard.
The hotel has two ocean-view swimming pools.
The hotel has a dedicated area of Fort Lauderdale Beach for Four Seasons guests.
The spa has six treatment rooms.
The 24-hour Fitness Centre was designed by Harley Pasternak.
Evelyn's Fort Lauderdale offers Mediterranean waterfront dining overlooking the Atlantic.
MAASS by Chef Ryan Ratino has a one-starred chef's counter.
The interiors and guest rooms were designed by Tara Bernerd.

highlights.text: Evelyn's Fort Lauderdale is one of the first Michelin-recommended restaurants in Fort Lauderdale.
Evelyn's blends Eastern Mediterranean techniques with Florida's seasonal produce.
The Signature Ebb & Flow Massage is enhanced by Himalayan singing bowls.
The spa has salt-wall saunas and aroma steam baths.
All guest rooms have furnished balconies.
The Kids For All Seasons daily program is based on the Ocean Sun Deck.

considerations.text: Valet parking is available at USD 67.41 per night, inclusive of taxes.
Condé Nast Traveler says it is hard to snag a reservation at Evelyn's.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflects the luxury positioning.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
